docs.subject: CCTV system – materials delivered (119 cameras, 4MP)
docs.notes: Total cameras: 119 Hikvision 4MP (dome fixed 54, dome varifocal 8, bullet fixed 5, bullet varifocal 52).

items.name: 15U rack 600 × 600
items.desc:
15U wall-mount network cabinet, 600 W × 600 D.
Glass front door, lockable, with side panels and cooling fan.

items.name: 27U rack
items.desc:
27U floor-standing network cabinet.
Lockable front door, removable side panels, ventilated top.

items.name: Hikvision 32-channel NVR
items.desc:
32-channel network video recorder for IP cameras, 4K output.
Supports multiple surveillance hard disks for continuous recording.

items.name: MDF 42U rack 800 × 1000
items.desc:
42U floor-standing MDF rack, 800 W × 1000 D.
Perforated front and rear doors, fans, castors and levelling feet.

items.name: 5 × 5" round waterproof PVC box for CCTV camera
items.desc:
Weatherproof PVC junction / back box for camera mounting.
Hides cable joints and connectors at each camera point.

items.name: Cable manager / organizer
items.desc:
1U rack-mount horizontal cable manager.
Keeps patch cords tidy between panels and switches.

items.name: Fibre core switch TP-Link 10G
items.desc:
Managed core switch with 10G SFP+ fibre ports.
Aggregates all access switches and NVRs on the fibre backbone.

items.name: D-Link PoE 24-port switch
items.desc:
24-port Gigabit PoE switch with uplink ports.
Powers and connects the IP cameras over a single Cat6 cable.

items.name: D-Link Gigabit 24-port switch
items.desc:
24-port Gigabit network switch (non-PoE).
For NVRs, workstations and monitoring equipment.

items.name: Fibre patch panel
items.desc:
Rack-mount fibre patch panel with adapters.
Terminates and organises the fibre backbone cores.

items.name: Optical fibre patch cable
items.desc:
Duplex optical fibre patch cord.
Connects the fibre patch panel to switch SFP ports.

items.name: Fibre splice box
items.desc:
Fibre termination / splice enclosure.
Protects fusion splices at each fibre end.

items.name: Schneider Cat6 keystone
items.desc:
Cat6 RJ45 keystone jack, unshielded.
For patch panel and faceplate terminations.

items.name: Cat6 keystone jack (CCTV)
items.desc:
Cat6 RJ45 keystone jack for camera points.
Terminates the camera cable at the back box.

items.name: Single faceplate (data)
items.desc:
Single-port data faceplate with shutter.
Wall outlet for data points.

items.name: Cat6 patch cable
items.desc:
Cat6 RJ45 patch cord with moulded boots.
Connects patch panels, switches and devices.

items.name: Schneider patch panel
items.desc:
24-port Cat6 rack-mount patch panel, 1U.
Terminates horizontal cabling in the racks.

items.name: PDU 32A 6-way
items.desc:
Rack-mount power distribution unit, 32A, 6 sockets.
Powers switches, NVRs and rack equipment.

items.name: CCTV industrial pole 2 m
items.desc:
Galvanised steel camera pole, 2 m height.
For outdoor camera mounting with base plate.

items.name: Single-mode fibre patch cable
items.desc:
Single-mode duplex fibre patch cord.
Links SFP modules to the fibre patch panels.

items.name: Surveillance hard disk 6TB (24×7)
items.desc:
6TB surveillance-grade hard disk rated for 24×7 recording.
Installed in the NVRs for continuous video storage.

items.name: Hikvision monitor 43 inch
items.desc:
43-inch Full HD monitor for 24×7 surveillance viewing.
For the video wall in the control room.

items.name: Video wall monitor wall bracket
items.desc:
Wall-mount bracket for video wall monitors.
Adjustable for flush, aligned installation.

items.name: HDMI 2.0 cable – MDF to video wall
items.desc:
High-speed HDMI 2.0 cable, 10 m / 15 m lengths.
Connects NVR outputs in the MDF to the video wall monitors.

items.name: Single-mode SFP module
items.desc:
1G / 10G single-mode SFP transceiver module.
Fibre uplink between core and access switches.

items.name: Wireless mouse
items.desc:
Wireless optical mouse with USB receiver.
For NVR and video wall operation.

items.name: Hikvision dome camera 4MP – fixed lens
items.desc:
4MP IP dome camera with fixed lens and IR night vision.
Indoor coverage, PoE powered.

items.name: Hikvision dome camera 4MP – varifocal
items.desc:
4MP IP dome camera with motorised varifocal lens and IR.
Adjustable zoom for wider or longer views, PoE powered.

items.name: Hikvision bullet camera 4MP – fixed lens
items.desc:
4MP IP bullet camera with fixed lens, IR night vision.
Weatherproof for outdoor use, PoE powered.

items.name: Hikvision bullet camera 4MP – varifocal
items.desc:
4MP IP bullet camera with motorised varifocal lens and IR.
Weatherproof outdoor coverage with adjustable zoom, PoE powered.
